commentary.pmax: July improved overall — higher conversion volume and value on slightly lower spend than June. Brand remained the strongest contributor and PMax improved with stronger conversion volume and ROAS; within PMax, General drove most of the uplift while Accounting softened slightly month-on-month. Accountant Insurance is still the main efficiency watch-point (though ROAS improved from June): the CPA ad group improved strongly, PI has started generating conversions and PL was softer. A new Management Consultants ad group has launched under Professional Indemnity and is still in early learning with limited data. Next focus: gradually reduce reliance on the broad General asset group and expand into targeted groups (Management Consultants, IT Contractors & Consultants) once data supports the split.
commentary.geo: Geographic conversions are sourced from Google Ads (source of truth). Awaiting the July geographic export — review strongest converting locations at campaign / asset-group level before adjusting.

landing.headline: Landing pages — July
landing.body: The Accountant Insurance landing page received more paid traffic in July (Paid Search + Cross-network sessions up 146 → 160) and average engagement time improved from ~70s to ~99s, with engagement rate broadly stable (~60%). Google Ads conversion efficiency is still weaker than the other core campaigns, so the landing page and quote journey remain key to monitor. Management Consultants is too early to assess (only ~7 paid sessions to the dedicated page; one Google Ads click so far). Public Liability attracted more paid landing-page traffic but engagement softened — monitor rather than change.
